description: Sewers is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Gold Coast. Geo-spatial layers depicting the approximate location of Sewer Maintenance Holes and Sewer Connections as of June 2015. Please note that as part of the atttribution of this data under the CC BY licence terms with which it is supplied, users should include the following statement: 'The information is provided to assist in field investigations. Coverage: City of Gold Coast. The portal files it under the publisher City of Gold Coast. Its tags are City of Gold Coast, CoGC, Geo-spatial, Gold Coast, Water. It offers 12 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, KMZ, URL, WFS. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
